scientific_integrity: The exact global phase theorem is proved analytically, with a supplementary exact and numerical checker; no independent validation is claimed. The Radó–Kneser–Choquet extension implication is classical and is not new.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to real a,b in (-1,1) and the boundary quotient on the unit circle. Related self-convolution and complex-parameter questions are not resolved. An unindexed classical equivalent criterion remains a residual originality risk.
title: A two-branch phase diagram for real Blaschke-quotient circle maps
